g.text: Current pure KDATP8 vs disabled: A3 P8+D8

g.text: OProjTP=1 in both arms; same current code, weights and serving configuration.
Change = (candidate / baseline - 1) x 100%; matched measured concurrency points only.
All valid repeats pooled. Whiskers show cross-run extrema where repeats exist, not confidence intervals.
4096 input / 1024 output; MTP5; PrefixCache ON (no local hits for this 4K workload).
P eager; D target/draft FULL_DECODE_ONLY; recurrent state remains on DP owners.
